verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data-export feature, open-format export (such as mbox or EML), or account-exit flow for Zero. Self-hosting, open-source code, Drizzle Studio's database viewer, and MCP read tools are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an export capability. The fact that mail lives in the underlying Gmail or other provider is a host-platform property, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
